meaning_short: The protected request carried the speculative prefill hint.
failure_meaning: The protected arm did not send the speculative-prefill hint.

when: Harness names the target turn B request
meaning_short: The warmup knew which next request it was meant to help.
failure_meaning: The run did not prove that the warmup targeted turn B.
what_it_means: The hint carries the exact turn-B request id that the warmup should target.

when: Dynamo declares the typed hint field
meaning_short: Dynamo has a typed speculative-prefill hint field.
failure_meaning: The source tree does not expose the speculative-prefill hint field.
what_it_means: Dynamo's OpenAI nvext schema has a real `speculative_prefill` field.

failure_meaning: The runtime did not show that the speculative-prefill wrapper ran.
what_it_means: The normal response stream passes through the speculative-prefill decision path.

meaning_short: The protected hint enabled the prefill path.
failure_meaning: The runtime did not show the protected hint enabling the prefill gate.
what_it_means: The decision gate reads `hints.speculative_prefill` and decides whether to continue.

meaning_short: A background prefill task was spawned.
failure_meaning: The runtime did not show a background prefill task.
what_it_means: Dynamo launches the background task that will build the next-turn warmup.

meaning_short: The warmup prompt was rendered and tokenized.
failure_meaning: The runtime did not show a rendered warmup prompt.
what_it_means: Dynamo rendered the predicted next-turn prefix and counted its tokens.

meaning_short: The warmup request was sent into the backend.
failure_meaning: The runtime did not show the warmup request being sent.
what_it_means: Dynamo sends the synthetic `max_tokens=1` warmup request into the backend path.

failure_meaning: The runtime did not show the warmup request completing.
what_it_means: Dynamo drains the warmup stream so the prefill lifecycle completes.

meaning_short: Runtime prefill events were parsed into the report.
failure_meaning: The report did not see speculative-prefill runtime events.
what_it_means: Postprocess collects `worker.spec_prefill.*` events from the worker runtime log.

when: Probe maps events into proof columns
meaning_short: The matrix includes direct prefill evidence columns.
failure_meaning: The matrix did not contain usable prefill proof columns.
what_it_means: The raw runtime events become `prefill_wrap`, `prefill_spawned`, `prefill_sent`, `prefill_done`, and `prefill_target_seen`.

meaning_short: The protected arm showed direct/inferred prefill evidence.
failure_meaning: The protected arm did not show usable speculative-prefill evidence.
what_it_means: The probe marks whether the protected arm had direct/inferred prefill evidence and whether turn B was faster.

meaning_short: The public Exp12 matrix was produced.
failure_meaning: The compact matrix was missing protected speculative-prefill rows.
what_it_means: The public report carries the probe proof fields into one compact matrix.

meaning_short: The public matrix preserved the prefill proof columns.
failure_meaning: The compact matrix dropped the columns needed to prove prefill behavior.
what_it_means: The compact matrix keeps the direct proof columns used by slides and debugging.

meaning_short: The public Exp12 summary outputs were generated.
failure_meaning: The public Exp12 matrix or summary was not generated.
